campaigns.title: 47th NEG-ECP Conference
campaigns.eyebrow: Commissioned event photography · Shelburne Farms · August 10, 2026
campaigns.intro: I photographed the 47th New England Governors and Eastern Canadian Premiers conference at Shelburne Farms, from the empty Coach Barn and arrivals through the working sessions and press conference.
campaigns.featuredAlt: A summit delegate gestures while speaking beneath United States and Canadian flags inside the Coach Barn.

story.title: From setup through the press conference
paragraphs: The empty Coach Barn established the setting. Once the conference began, I moved between wide views, individual speakers, reactions, and smaller exchanges around the table.
Cynosure, Inc. commissioned the photography through its sister organization, Greater Burlington Industrial Corporation.

campaigns.title: Vermont Foodbank Volunteer Day
campaigns.intro: Volunteers packed food for distribution inside the Vermont Foodbank warehouse. I photographed each step of the packing line and the people doing the work.

story.title: The packing line
paragraphs: Volunteers opened boxes, sorted food, and moved packed cases toward the pallets waiting at the end of the line.
I worked beside the line so the photographs show both the full warehouse and the work at each station.

story.title: Late sun, storm clouds, and blue hour
paragraphs: The weather moved from broken sunlight to a dark blue evening, changing the river and skyline from one frame to the next.
Tower Bridge and the Shard became fixed points as the light shifted around them.
